description: A frontend HTML page for a Database Viewer web application. It provides UI components and embedded JavaScript for browsing databases, tables, and viewing table data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases from the backend API.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a specific table and renders it as a table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell, with special handling for objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
